name: carousel
purpose: Shows one slide at a time from a set (featured items, an onboarding tour, image sets), following the WAI-ARIA APG carousel: a named region with roledescription 'carousel', slides labelled 'N of M', previous/next buttons and slide pickers, inert inactive slides. No autoplay by default; with autoplay, a pause button comes first, rotation pauses on hover and focus, and it does not start for reduced motion.
whenToUse: A few related items of equal weight that do not all need to be visible at once.
A short step-through such as an onboarding tour.
whenNotToUse: Important content every user must see (most users never see slides after the first).
Many items: use a list or a grid.
responsive: Slides take the full width of the carousel; swiping on touch screens moves between slides; controls wrap under the slides.
rtl: Slides move from right to left; swipe directions and the track mirror.
theme: Component tokens carousel-radius (radius-md) and carousel-indicator (color-primary, 3:1 against color-surface in the contrast gate); the current picker dot is filled. Controls are Buttons. The slide transition uses the shared motion tokens and is off for reduced motion and animation 'none'.
security: String content is rendered as text; Node content is inserted as given (the application owns it).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Up to 100 slides; all slides are in the DOM (inert when not shown).

limitations: One slide is shown at a time.
Swiping is for touch and pen; mouse users use the buttons.
unsupported: Several slides per view, peeking neighbours, or free scrolling (use Scroll Area with a horizontal strip).
antiPatterns: Autoplay without a reason; most carousels should not rotate.
Putting the only call to action on a later slide.
